text:
ana (PM): Kicking off a post-bench feedback swimlane for Halo silicon beta. Goal: capture NDA-safe notes, technical blockers, and next steps for marketplace packaging. Can HW confirm repro of p99 spike on 8k seq?

devon (bench): Quick summary from yesterday's run: throughput matches expectations but p99 jumps to ~480ms on 8k seq when KV-cache misses hit. Baseline on our Ampere lab was ~320ms. Raw logs sanitized and uploaded. Snippet: ```run-id: halo-2026-03-18
cmd: ./bench --model redwood-13b-8k --batch 8 --seq 8192
p99: 480ms
notes: KV cache miss amplification on initial tokens```

mike (hw-eng): Thanks. Were those runs using the INT8 quantized path? On our side we observed memory-bandwidth contention causing stalls at small batch sizes. Can you push the perf counters (PMU) from the redacted artifact? e.g. mem_bw, llc_miss, ipc.

tori (partner:halo): From Halo side we validated a similar pattern on our silicon with driver v1.4.2. We have a firmware patch that reduces the stalls; happy to provide for testing. Reminder: per NDA do not paste raw logs in public channels — will DM the driver artifact.

kate (legal): Confirmed. Please put sanitized artifacts into the shared NDA folder and run the redaction script before sending outside the NDA group: `scripts/redact_logs.sh`. If anybody needs help with the redaction rules ping me.

devon (bench): Uploading sanitized artifacts (NDA folder). Internal link: <redacted-drive-link>. Also including a minimal repro script for lab runs: ```python
# minimal repro for p99
from runner import Bench
bench = Bench(model='redwood-13b-8k', batch=8, seq=8192)
bench.run(save='artifact.json')
```

mike (hw-eng): I'll run the Halo firmware patch in our lab on Tue and collect PMU counters. Action items: mike - run patched driver + capture perf counters; devon - confirm redacted perf counters & attach run metadata; tori - share patched driver + test vector; ana - coordinate marketplace packaging timeline and messaging.

deploy-bot: buildbot: Halo driver patch build #234 completed and artifact uploaded to partner-staging (internal only).

tori (partner:halo): DM'ed the driver + small testset. Also proposing a 30m pairing session tomorrow 09:30 PT to walk through the repro and perf counter collection — can you confirm?

devon (bench): 09:30 PT works for bench team. I'll send a calendar invite. Quick clarification: are we running with TLS enabled? Encrypted transport adds ~5-10ms; keep consistent across comparisons.

ana (typo correction) -- ignore

ana (PM): (edited) Keep TLS setting consistent across runs and record it in the run metadata. Also include exact model version, tokenizer commit, and quantization flags. I'll add a checklist in the shared tracker: run-metadata, perf-counters, redacted-artifact, driver-version, pairing-notes.

mike (hw-eng): Noted. Tagging this issue priority:high for infra support. I'll post perf counter dumps to the NDA folder once complete.

kate (legal): Once we have a stable perf delta and sanitized summary, legal can sign off on a short marketplace blurb — please route the draft through me.

ana (PM): Timeline proposal: close feedback loop by end of next sprint (target 2026-04-01). If p99 stabilizes under ~360ms with the patch, we can begin drafting the marketplace listing and joint announcement language. :rocket:

tori (partner:halo): Acknowledged. I'll be on the pairing call and will bring an engineer who owns the firmware.

devon (bench): Invite sent. For the pairing session I'll bring a reduced repro that toggles KV cache warm/cold states.

ana (PM): Thanks all — moving to action items in the tracker. I'll update the sprint card with owners and due dates. :+1:
